scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/web-preact
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/server && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace apps/web-preact
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contract && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web-preact && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
